test_title: PYST 7: SSC CGL 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 02 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements :**

I. All A are H.

II. No B is A.

**Conclusion :**

I. Some A are not B.

II. No B is H.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follows

solution:
The pattern followed here is:

The least possible Venn diagram is shown below according to the given information.

Statements :

I. All A are H.

II. No B is A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/31b924de2b2d12643bb3691371211706b4c842bd6890a29000c4d8d0e3aa75df.png] 

Conclusion :

I. Some A are not B → **Follow **→ As all A are H and No B is A. So some are not B is definitely followed.

II. No B is H → **Does not follow **→ As all A are H and No B is A. No B is H is not definitely true because there is a possibility as Some B are H. So it is not followed.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
